item.title: Rockstar Responds to GTA 6 Leaks as Take-Two Targets Microsoft, Discord, X and YouTube
item.description: Rockstar Games has not issued a conventional public statement about the latest GTA 6 leaks, but its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, has delivered a considerably less subtle response: copyright takedowns, federal court filings and an expanding effort to identify whoever is behind the unauthorized footage.
